    Good stages #

    A stage Y_K is good when it is cycle-free, interval-finite and simply connected (Good). If P is loop-free, the lift of u at a point ⟨b, w⟩ with w ∉ K survives in Y_K (uT_not_mem): a factorization through a killed lift at another point ⟨b, w'⟩ would need a nonzero endomorphism of b of class w⁻¹ w' ≠ 1. The lifts of the uᵢ survive in every stage (usT_not_mem).

    In a loop-free category the lift of u survives at points outside K.

    The lifts of the aᵢ at points of K lie in the ideal of Y_K, hence so does ũ.

      One more point: a good stage stays good when the lifts at one point are restored.
